title: Lapsed Exit Requests and the Lease Term Agreement Notice Charge — Bulletin
content:
**Lapse multiplier on an exit notice charge.** The insufficient notice charge on a lease-break request against a Lease Term Agreement carries a lapse multiplier set by the other lease-break and Early Termination Option requests on the same term that were withdrawn or expired, a withdrawn statutory release, transfer or rescission request not counting: two or more raise the charge to 150 percent; exactly one raises it to 125 percent; none leaves it at 100 percent.

**What counts.** Requests on the same term whose type is a lease break or the Early Termination Option and whose status is withdrawn or expired.

**What does not count.** Statutory release, transfer and renewal rescission requests, whatever their status; requests that are submitted, quoted or signed.

| Lapsed lease-break or Early Termination Option requests on the term | Lapse multiplier |
|---|---|
| none | 100 percent (1) |
| exactly one | 125 percent (1.25) |
| two or more | 150 percent (1.50) |

The multiplier multiplies the charge, and no figure is rounded before the charge itself.

**Illustrations (hypothetical).** One expired Early Termination Option request and one withdrawn transfer request on the term: one counts, 125 percent. One withdrawn lease-break request and one expired lease-break request: 150 percent.
